summary.text: Lance Bell, a Republican, has represented District 11 in the Alabama State Senate since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he is an attorney who has worked as a prosecutor for Pell City, as an investigator with the St. Clair County District Attorney's Office, and as a partner at the law firm Trussell, Funderburg, Rea, Bell & Furgerson.
He has served as chairman of the St. Clair County Republican Party.
